import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    
    best_dif = 1e9
    best_b = 0
    best_a = 0
    
    for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
        a1 = math.ceil(b * x / y)
        a2 = math.floor(b * x / y)
        
        dif1 = abs(x / y - a2 / b)
        if dif1 < best_dif:
            best_dif = dif1
            best_a = a2
            best_b = b
            
        dif2 = abs(x / y - a1 / b)
        if dif2 < best_dif:
            best_dif = dif2
            best_a = a1
            best_b = b
    
    print(f"{int(best_a)}/{int(best_b)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
